summary: Vendored flutter_background 1.3.1 as a local MIT fork and made its Android Gradle script compatible with both legacy KGP and AGP built-in Kotlin modes. Android Debug builds pass in both modes; signed Release builds pass in both modes, and all generated APKs verify with APK Signature Scheme v2. Android CI now runs the two-mode Debug matrix. No device or ADB was used.

checks.name: Legacy-KGP Debug and split ABI Release builds
checks.command: cd desktop && bash scripts/android_release/verify_android_kotlin_modes.sh; JAVA_HOME=<JDK 17> flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --no-pub
checks.observation: The default android.builtInKotlin=false Debug build passed. The signed split Release build produced arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 APKs (approximately 38 MB, 30 MB and 43 MB); each APK verified with apksigner and APK Signature Scheme v2.

checks.name: AGP built-in Kotlin Debug and signed Release builds
checks.observation: Debug and signed universal Release builds completed successfully with built-in Kotlin enabled; the universal APK verified with apksigner and APK Signature Scheme v2.

checks.name: Flutter application regression suite
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub --no-fatal-infos
checks.observation: All 326 Flutter tests passed and flutter analyze reported no issues.

checks.name: Android CI build-mode gate
checks.observation: Added to .github/workflows/ci-flutter.yaml; local execution passed both Debug build modes. Remote CI execution is pending push.

limitations: Flutter continues to emit its KGP migration warning for flutter_background, flutter_webrtc and livekit_client because plugin source declarations remain visible to Flutter's detector.

The built-in Kotlin Release gate produced a signed universal APK; the legacy mode produced signed per-ABI APKs. The full three-ABI release packaging matrix was not repeated with built-in Kotlin enabled.
No Android device, runtime behavior, install, or ADB validation was performed.
remaining: Migrate the remaining flutter_webrtc and livekit_client KGP declarations, determine how to clear Flutter's plugin detector warning, run the new matrix in remote CI, and repeat a signed split-ABI Release build with built-in Kotlin enabled before changing the default mode.
